epics.title: EPIC-1 — Tenant & Access Control
epics.description: Enable secure authentication, additive role-based authorization enforcement, and strict tenant isolation.

stories.title: STORY-1.1 — Authenticate User and Resolve Tenant Context
stories.description: Return authenticated user identity, role, and tenant scope on every request.
acceptanceCriteria: Valid JWT returns user context including user_id, role, tenant_id, and linked member_id
Invalid or expired token returns AUTH_REQUIRED or INVALID_TOKEN error
tenant_id is derived from authenticated context only; client-supplied tenant_id is ignored
All responses are scoped to the authenticated tenant

stories.title: STORY-1.2 — Enforce Additive Role-Based Access Control
stories.description: Enforce additive RBAC where Admin inherits all Leader capabilities and Leader inherits all Member capabilities.
acceptanceCriteria: Member can perform only Member-scoped actions
Leader can perform all Member actions plus leader-scoped actions
Admin can perform all Leader and Member actions plus admin-scoped actions
Unauthorized access returns FORBIDDEN_ROLE error
Leader access is further restricted to assigned members for confirmation workflows
Cross-tenant access is blocked with CROSS_TENANT_ACCESS error

epics.title: EPIC-2 — Member & Group Management
epics.description: Enable creation and management of members, groups, and leader assignments.

stories.title: STORY-2.1 — Create and Manage Members
stories.description: Enable admin to create, update, and soft-delete members.
acceptanceCriteria: Member created with required fields (first_name, last_name, email, tenant_id)
Updates persist correctly
Soft-deleted members are excluded from active lists, RSVP, self-report, and confirmation workflows
Unique active email enforced per tenant

stories.title: STORY-2.2 — Assign Members to Groups and Leaders
stories.description: Enable assignment of members to groups and to Pastoral Leaders.
acceptanceCriteria: Members can be assigned to groups
Leader-to-member relationships are stored and retrievable
Duplicate active assignments are prevented
Groups can be used for event targeting

epics.title: EPIC-3 — Event Lifecycle Management
epics.description: Enable full lifecycle management of events including state transitions, versioning, and expected member materialization.

stories.title: STORY-3.1 — Create and Publish Event
stories.description: Enable admin to create and schedule an event with required fields and notification configuration.
acceptanceCriteria: Event starts in DRAFT state
Publish transitions event to SCHEDULED
Required fields validated (event_type_id, name, start_datetime, end_datetime, location_name, target)
end_datetime must be after start_datetime
Expected members materialized on scheduling
Notification schedules created for pre-event reminder, post-event self-report prompt, and leader confirmation tasks

stories.title: STORY-3.2 — Manage Event State Transitions
stories.description: Automatically transition event through lifecycle states at the correct times.
acceptanceCriteria: SCHEDULED transitions to ACTIVE at start_datetime
ACTIVE transitions to COMPLETED at end_datetime
COMPLETED transitions to LOCKED after attendance window closes
Cancelled events suppress all pending notifications and block RSVP, self-report, and confirmation actions

stories.title: STORY-3.3 — Update Event and Trigger Notifications
stories.description: Allow event updates with version tracking and change notifications.
acceptanceCriteria: Updates increment the event version
Event update triggers a notification to expected members with changed details
Immutable fields cannot be edited after notifications have been sent
Reschedule of timing recalculates unsent notification schedules

epics.title: EPIC-4 — RSVP Management
epics.description: Enable members to submit RSVP intent before events with validation rules including mandatory reason for No.

stories.title: STORY-4.1 — Submit RSVP Response
stories.description: Enable member to submit pre-event attendance intent.
acceptanceCriteria: Member can submit RSVP Yes or No before event start
Response is stored with responded_at timestamp
Latest RSVP overwrites previous (upsert on event_id + member_id)
RSVP never creates or modifies official attendance

stories.title: STORY-4.2 — Enforce RSVP No Reason Requirement
stories.description: Ensure RSVP No responses require a reason.
acceptanceCriteria: RSVP No submission without reason is rejected with RSVP_REASON_REQUIRED error
Reason is stored with the RSVP record
RSVP Yes does not require a reason

epics.title: EPIC-5 — Member Attendance Self-Report
epics.description: Enable members to self-report their attendance after events with optional feedback and star rating (Yes), or mandatory reason (No).

stories.title: STORY-5.1 — Submit Post-Event Attendance Self-Report
stories.description: Enable member to self-report attendance after event ends.
acceptanceCriteria: Member can submit Yes or No self-report only after event transitions to COMPLETED
Yes self-report: optional feedback text (max 1000 chars) and optional star_rating (integer 1–5) accepted
Yes self-report is saved as SELF_REPORTED_YES with status PENDING_CONFIRMATION
Member may not re-submit self-report for the same event after first submission
Self-report is stored separately from official attendance

stories.title: STORY-5.2 — Enforce Self-Report No Reason Requirement
stories.description: Ensure No self-reports require a reason and are immediately resolved as DID_NOT_ATTEND.
acceptanceCriteria: No self-report without reason is rejected
No self-report with reason is accepted
No self-report immediately creates official attendance_status = DID_NOT_ATTEND without requiring leader confirmation
No leader notification is generated for a No self-report

epics.title: EPIC-6 — Leader Confirmation Workflow
epics.description: Enable Pastoral Leaders to confirm or reject member Yes self-reports, producing the official attendance record.

stories.title: STORY-6.1 — Notify Leader of Member Yes Self-Report
stories.description: Trigger a confirmation task notification to the assigned leader when a member self-reports Yes.
acceptanceCriteria: Leader receives push notification: '[Member Name] reported they attended [Event Name]. Please confirm.'
Notification is sent only for Yes self-reports
Notification is sent only to the member's assigned Pastoral Leader
If no leader is assigned, notification is sent to admin

stories.title: STORY-6.2 — Confirm or Reject Member Self-Report
stories.description: Enable leader to confirm or reject a member's Yes self-report to produce official attendance.
acceptanceCriteria: Leader can view member name, event, self-report timestamp, feedback (if any), and star rating (if any)
Leader Confirm → official attendance_status = ATTENDED
Leader Reject → official attendance_status = DID_NOT_ATTEND
Confirmation is final; member cannot re-submit
Leader can only confirm for assigned members
Confirmation is audited with confirmed_by and confirmed_at

stories.title: STORY-6.3 — Resolve No Self-Report as DID_NOT_ATTEND
stories.description: Immediately create official DID_NOT_ATTEND when member self-reports No.
acceptanceCriteria: No self-report with reason immediately creates official attendance_status = DID_NOT_ATTEND
No leader confirmation notification is sent
Record is audited

stories.title: STORY-6.4 — Admin Override of Official Attendance
stories.description: Allow admin to directly record or override official attendance for any member in the tenant.
acceptanceCriteria: Admin can set attendance_status to ATTENDED or DID_NOT_ATTEND for any expected member
Override is allowed regardless of self-report status
Override is audited with actor_id, reason (optional), and timestamp
Override cannot be performed after event is LOCKED

stories.title: STORY-6.5 — View Self-Report Context During Confirmation
stories.description: Enable leader to view member self-report details including feedback and star rating when confirming.
acceptanceCriteria: Confirmation screen shows member name, self-report timestamp, feedback text (if provided), star rating (if provided)
RSVP status and reason are also visible as additional context
Only assigned members are visible to the leader

stories.title: STORY-6.6 — Lock Official Attendance Records
stories.description: Prevent all attendance changes after event is LOCKED.
acceptanceCriteria: Official attendance records cannot be modified after event is LOCKED
Leader confirmation attempts after lock return ATTENDANCE_NOT_OPEN error
Admin override is also blocked after lock

epics.title: EPIC-7 — Formation Tracking Engine
epics.description: Enable deterministic formation progress tracking derived exclusively from leader-confirmed ATTENDED records.

stories.title: STORY-7.1 — Link Formation Event to Talk
stories.description: Enable linking of a formation event to a specific Talk in the formation structure.
acceptanceCriteria: Formation event requires valid talk_id
Invalid or soft-deleted talk_id is rejected
One event maps to at most one talk

stories.title: STORY-7.2 — Compute Formation Progress from Confirmed Attendance
stories.description: Calculate talk, module, and course completion based exclusively on leader-confirmed ATTENDED attendance.
acceptanceCriteria: Talk is complete only when official attendance_status = ATTENDED for a formation event linked to that talk
RSVP Yes does not complete a talk
SELF_REPORTED_YES (pending confirmation) does not complete a talk
DID_NOT_ATTEND does not complete a talk
Module completion is correct when all talks in the module are complete
Course completion is correct when all talks across all modules are complete

epics.title: EPIC-8 — Notification System
epics.description: Enable reliable delivery of pre-event reminders, post-event self-report prompts, and leader confirmation task notifications with retry and failure handling.

stories.title: STORY-8.1 — Send Pre-Event Reminder Notifications
stories.description: Deliver pre-event reminder with event details and RSVP prompt to expected members.
acceptanceCriteria: Notification includes What (event name), When (datetime), Where (location + navigation link)
RSVP question is included: 'Are you attending?'
Delivered to all expected members per configured reminder schedule
Delivered via push channel

stories.title: STORY-8.2 — Send Post-Event Self-Report Prompt to Members
stories.description: Deliver post-event attendance self-report notification to expected members after event ends.
acceptanceCriteria: Notification is sent to all expected members after event transitions to COMPLETED
Notification asks: 'Did you attend [Event Name]?'
Notification includes Yes and No response options
Notification is not sent for cancelled events

stories.title: STORY-8.3 — Send Leader Confirmation Task Notification
stories.description: Deliver confirmation task push notification to assigned leader when a member self-reports Yes.
acceptanceCriteria: Leader receives notification: '[Member Name] reported they attended [Event Name]. Please confirm.'
Notification is triggered only for Yes self-reports
Notification routes leader to the confirmation screen for that member and event
Notification is not sent for No self-reports

stories.title: STORY-8.4 — Retry Failed Notifications
stories.description: Ensure reliable notification delivery through retry and failure handling.
acceptanceCriteria: Up to 3 delivery attempts per recipient
Transient failures retried with exponential backoff
Permanent failures logged and moved to dead-letter queue
Notification status (pending, sent, failed) is queryable

epics.title: EPIC-9 — Reporting & Metrics
epics.description: Enable reporting across RSVP intent, member self-report status, official confirmed attendance, and formation progress.

stories.title: STORY-9.1 — Generate RSVP Reports
stories.description: Provide visibility into pre-event RSVP intent.
acceptanceCriteria: Filter by event, group, member
Yes/No/No-Response distribution shown
RSVP reason visible for No responses

stories.title: STORY-9.2 — Generate Attendance Reports
stories.description: Provide attendance insights distinguishing self-report status from official confirmed attendance.
acceptanceCriteria: Filter by event, group, member, date range
Report shows: self-report status (Yes/No/No-Response) and official attendance status (ATTENDED/DID_NOT_ATTEND/PENDING_CONFIRMATION/UNRESPONDED)
Missing official attendance identified (expected members without a final official record)
Reports respect RBAC: leaders see only assigned members

stories.title: STORY-9.3 — Generate Formation Progress Reports
stories.description: Provide formation progress insights based only on confirmed ATTENDED records.
acceptanceCriteria: Progress shown by member, talk, module, course
Completion metrics are based only on official ATTENDED status
Accurate aggregation at module and course level

epics.title: EPIC-10 — Audit & Compliance
epics.description: Enable full auditability of all RSVP, self-report, leader confirmation, and administrative actions.

stories.title: STORY-10.1 — Log Audit Events
stories.description: Capture all critical system actions with before and after values.
acceptanceCriteria: RSVP submissions and updates logged
Member self-report submissions logged
Leader confirmation (confirm and reject) actions logged
Admin attendance overrides logged
Event create, update, cancel actions logged
Before/after values stored for all mutations
Audit logs are immutable (no update or delete paths)

stories.title: STORY-10.2 — Query Audit Logs
stories.description: Allow authorized admin to view and filter audit logs.
acceptanceCriteria: Filter by entity_type, entity_id, action, actor_id, date range
Only Senior Coordinator or authorized admin roles can access
Tenant-scoped: no cross-tenant log access
